description: This file contains tests for a FastAPI application, specifically testing query parameter handling, validation, and OpenAPI schema generation. It uses pytest and FastAPI's TestClient to send requests and verify responses, including validation errors and schema output.

methods.name: get_client(request: pytest.FixtureRequest)
methods.description: Fixture that dynamically imports a module based on the parameter and creates a FastAPI TestClient to be used in tests.

methods.name: test_query_param_model(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests that a GET request to /items/ with specific query parameters returns the expected JSON response with status 200.

methods.name: test_query_param_model_defaults(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests default behavior for /items/ endpoint when no query parameters are supplied.

methods.name: test_query_param_model_invalid(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests validation errors when invalid query parameters are supplied, asserts that response matches a stored snapshot.

methods.name: test_query_param_model_extra(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests validation error when an extra query parameter not permitted is provided, verifies error response.

methods.name: test_openapi_schema(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Requests the /openapi.json endpoint and verifies that the returned OpenAPI schema matches the expected snapshot.
